newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse confirms price limit widening Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse confirms price limit widening Aug 1.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand confirmed on Friday that it will widen the daily stock price trading limit to 30 percent from 10 percent on August 1.
The decision was made after the exchange board met on Friday and reached agreement on the issue with member brokerages, Singh Tangtasawas, the bourse president told reporters.
"The new price limit will be effective from August 1. This is to give member brokerages and investors more time to study and adjust themselves," Singh said.

During the bourse's rally over the past three days, most major stocks jumped to their 10 percent upper daily limit within the first few hours of trade, and orders could not be completed. The ten percent limit is also a floor.
Thai stocks have gained more than 130 points in the past three days. The key SET index was up 42.07 or 6.81 percent at 660.05 in late afternoon dealings.
